statePlans.actualEvidence: Gymnasium-applicable SekI 3.9 page 40: Vorkommen/Verwendung plus optional context Vom Erdöl zum Benzin. Actual Q section 3.2.2 page 33: polymer production/recycling with possible petroleum-to-monomers context.
statePlans.resolution: These genuine Gymnasium contexts permit authoring an optional application/extension placement, but do not establish two compulsory refinery mechanisms. The non-Gymnasium EP italic row must not be presented as obligatory Gym proof.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: Keep required HC/polymer competencies via their actual narrower targets. For the two mechanism children, review a clearly labelled optional application branch or find explicit Gymnasium processing evidence; no automatic replacement by current generic mappings.
statePlans.stillOpen: Default target semantics versus optional selection is not resolved by a label or source metadata. Preserve the existing authored competence in the inactive v1 until a reviewed correct scope is available.

statePlans.actualEvidence: Primary Gymnasium page 41 end-of-grade-8 processing-diagram competence; 2022 restriction page 3 explicitly retains Erde als Rohstofflieferant in grade 8.
statePlans.resolution: An explicit supplied fractional-distillation route can be a partial witness for the actual diagram competence. The source does not specify the separate thermal cracking requirement.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: A direct partial distillation mapping can replace false inference from the broad ancestor; preserve the required diagram competence and review grade-8 model demands/frontier. Do not claim mandatory both-child coverage.
statePlans.stillOpen: Thermal-cracking state scope and the suitability of unchanged 2be prerequisite for the grade-8 route.

statePlans.actualEvidence: Actual page 55 Baustein8.5 Raffination/product palette; GK W-table page26 and LK W-table page29; teaching proposals93/98 mention catalysis with cracking.
statePlans.resolution: Genuine optional refinery route for both courses, not universal LK-only or compulsory coverage. Thermal-versus-catalytic distinction remains real.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: Correct only five8.5 extraction cell course/page/optional fields, retain stable source IDs/raw text, create a versioned successor and narrow direct partial processing binding. Existing alkanol-classification edge does not support refining.
statePlans.stillOpen: Correct optional target placement and procedure subtype; do not silently add a catalytic atom because the optional module has not been selected.

statePlans.actualEvidence: Primary NW EP page31: mandatory distillation; possible cracking experiment.
statePlans.resolution: Mandatory distillation is genuinely preserved in its specific branch. Actual experiment suggestion does not establish both child mechanisms as compulsory.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: Direct partial distillation source binding with NW-branch qualification; preserve separately the optional experiment and do not claim actual execution from model-only P.
statePlans.stillOpen: NW-versus-sprachlich/upper-course authored scope and optional cracking selection.

statePlans.actualEvidence: Class9 LB3 page17 petroleum fractions; WB2 page18 optional cracking, experiment/elimination/Olefin-Verbund.
statePlans.resolution: Narrow theoretical chemical conversion contributes to an optional WB2 source component. Required LB3 fraction knowledge must survive via genuine mixture/use/property goals.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: Retain LB3 actual requirements; qualify WB2 partial cracking binding as optional with separate performance residuals. Do not use WB2 to certify a mandatory E-phase industrial mechanism.
statePlans.stillOpen: Experimental execution, application of elimination knowledge, Olefin-Verbund, optional placement and any genuine fractional-distillation competence.

statePlans.actualEvidence: Bounded primary topic route discovery found general organics/petroleum-mixture/use or polymer sources, not a clear mandatory two-procedure clause. Exact current broad-source snapshots are in the inventory; per-file route hits are retained separately.
statePlans.resolution: Do not invent a full thermal-cracking/destillation source requirement. This is a bounded nonverification, not a claim that all possible curricular evidence is absent.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: Preserve actual named structural/property/use/assessment requirements through their real existing targets and partial/union coverage; do not map the new procedure atoms merely by old e8c/root descent. Keep the authored split scope on hold or review a legitimate optional enrichment placement.
statePlans.stillOpen: Genuine narrow state source witnesses or correct optional scope semantics. No reviewed author-view retirement has been prepared.

statePlans.actualEvidence: No current direct8ceb source/goalEntry witness. Actual authored reachability checker exposes neither new child in these state views. BY chemical-source JSON and reviewed9/10 pages lack current narrow processing proof.
statePlans.resolution: There is no valid existing state target placement to preserve for this parent; raw compatibility declaration alone is not target visibility or normative coverage.
statePlans.necessaryDelta: No child source clone and no new state placement. Preserve valid petroleum-use/property source targets unchanged; any future extension requires an explicit source/scope review.
statePlans.stillOpen: Raw parent/child compatibility declaration must not be labelled independently source-approved.

mandatoryContentPreservation: Preserve each genuine required source component on actual assessable targets. Retain authored whole-competence scope as an inactive candidate; no unsupported proof, active retirement or threshold lowering.
